hero.title: MEBO Wound Ointment
hero.lead: Our flagship topical regenerative medicine for burn and wounds.

s1.p1: MEBO Wound Ointment is a topical medicine for treating burns and wounds. It combines multiple naturally-derived active ingredients with a patented dosage form.
s1.p2: The ointment provides a physiological moist environment, liquefies and removes necrotic tissues, reduces pain, prevents and controls infection, prevents and minimizes scar formation, and promotes in situ skin regeneration.

s4.lead: Seven complementary actions support the wound from protection to regeneration.

s5.lead: An animated explanation of how regenerative medicine technology works at the cellular level.

s6.lead: Three application methods, chosen according to the wound type and condition. Clean the wound gently — never use sterile solutions or antiseptics.

s7.lead: Beyond our flagship ointment, MEBO extends regenerative science across five product categories.

cta.p: Access professional resources, complete clinical data, and technical documentation for healthcare professionals.
